title: 0/1 Knapsack with Attribute Weights
statement: You have a knapsack of capacity W and N items. Each item has a weight w[i] and value v[i]. Determine the maximum total value of items that can fit inside the knapsack without exceeding capacity W.
input_format: First line: N W. Next N lines: w[i] v[i].
output_format: Print a single integer: the maximum achievable value.
